info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Approved Supplier Directory API
info.description: The Approved Supplier Directory API allows users to access a curated list of approved suppliers for enterprise services. This resource is essential for businesses seeking reliable partners and vendors for their operational needs. Developers can utilize this API to retrieve supplier details, ensuring compliance with organizational policies and enhancing procurement efficiency. Typical consumers include purchasing departments, vendors, and integration systems that require supplier validation.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a list of approved suppliers within the enterprise services. The response includes details such as supplier names, contact information, and approval status, facilitating quick access to vetted suppliers.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving the approved supplier directory through the enterprise services. This should contain the necessary parameters to filter and fetch the required data in JSON format.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the approved supplier directory.

GetApprovedSupplierDirectoryRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on the approved supplier directory service. It is expected to contain the necessary input in string format.
